fieldValues.title: Name the clusters
fieldValues.description: Weekly: read each domain container with unclustered depth-0 problems, suggest named clusters with descriptions in Suggestions under agent:synthesizer, and propose the outline move (clusters at depth 0, problems at depth 1). May add, merge, reshape and rename its own suggested clusters; never touches an affirmed cluster beyond adding problems to it; never affirms.
fieldValues.done_when: Each domain read has its unclustered problems grouped under suggested clusters that differ clearly from their neighbours (or is reported as needing none), one programme PR and a run report say how each new or changed cluster differs, and the digest issue lists what the owner is asked to affirm.
